pullRequests.title: PAL: add 20 independently reviewed reconstructions
pullRequests.author: Sumaiter
pullRequests.head: work/pal-reviewed-next20
pullRequests.body:
This draft adds 20 independently reviewed PAL reconstructions: 1,844 distinct function bytes across 33 physical placements. The functions cover stdio allocation, scalar menu helpers, four message-record construction, descriptor setters and the complete shared 64-byte validation body. Two existing message-helper parameter declarations are made consistent with the already matched unsigned-word callers.

pullRequests.author: Sumaiter
pullRequests.head: work/pal-nonmatching-drafts-20261115
pullRequests.body:
This preserves 91 compiler-backed PAL C drafts for further decompilation: 88 from the retained local archive and three from the newly handed-off batches. Each draft lives under nonmatching/pal/<area>/, with a PAL reproduction command, the retained-object comparison, and unresolved review questions. The README indexes every added file.
